nodes.text: @dineshgrao I agree with most of the facts, save one.  HMPV "can" be deadly. It is one of the leading causes of viral pneumonia. With that being said, Rhinovirus is the leading cause of viral pneumonia. So much like a common cold, taking care of yourself can keep you safe.
